    位姿精修与深度对比

    RGB、MegaPose RGB-D 与 WAPR 的结果应在同一套图像、模型、相机与单位约定下比较。先跑通 RGB、MegaPose 和 WAPR 各自教程，再保存对应输出。

    同一帧，分别保存各分支

    PYTHON
    # tester、image_bgr、cam_K 和米制 depth_m 已按前面的教程准备。
rgb_results = tester.predict(cam_K, image_bgr, [1])
megapose_results = tester.predict(cam_K, image_bgr, [1], depth=depth_m, use_megapose=True)

    WAPR 通过独立掩码接口处理该帧，不覆盖上面两个结果字典。对照时保留物体编号及各分支实例对应关系；不能仅凭排名或画面位置把不同检测视为同一实例。

    保存 show_6D_vis1、show_6D_vis2 及 MegaPose 调试图可检查投影。需要数值对照时先检查 PnP 成功标记和精修有效索引，再统一平移单位：HccePose / MegaPose 返回毫米，WAPR 示例 JSON 返回米。

    深度反投影

    在彩色图坐标系内，以米制深度 z 与相机内参反投影：

    PYTHON
    import numpy as np

height, width = depth_m.shape
u, v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(width), np.arange(height))
valid = np.isfinite(depth_m) & (depth_m > 0)
z = depth_m[valid]
x = (u[valid] - cam_K[0, 2]) * z / cam_K[0, 0]
y = (v[valid] - cam_K[1, 2]) * z / cam_K[1, 1]
points_camera_m = np.column_stack([x, y, z])

    这里的 cam_K 对应原图，不能换用处理后画布内参；前提是深度已经按同一相机模型配准和校正。无效深度不生成点。对齐时把米制网格顶点用米制位姿变换到相机坐标系，不要给点云再重复乘一次位姿。

    图层与视角

    点云是观测表面，网格是根据估计位姿放置的模型。观察时可用不同颜色、散点与实面区分两者；旋转检查遮挡区域后，应能复位到相机对齐视角。交互操作形式见 WAPR RGB-D 查看器。

    对称物体可能有多种等价姿态；局部点云缺失也不自动说明位姿错误。投影、深度一致性用于检查几何，精度结论需要与独立真值对比并使用相应评测指标。

    公开结果与评测

    公开示例图见 MegaPose 与 RGB，历史公开基准见 BOP 评测。不同后端的评分定义不同，不能直接把其数值相减来判断谁更准确。首次准备耗时与重复推理耗时应分别记录。

    Refinement and depth comparison

    Compare RGB, MegaPose RGB-D and WAPR with the same images, models, calibration and unit conventions. First run the RGB, MegaPose and WAPR tutorials separately, then preserve each branch’s outputs.

    Preserve results for the same frame

    PYTHON
    # Prepare tester, image_bgr, cam_K and meter depth_m using the preceding tutorials.
rgb_results = tester.predict(cam_K, image_bgr, [1])
megapose_results = tester.predict(cam_K, image_bgr, [1], depth=depth_m, use_megapose=True)

    WAPR handles this frame through the separate mask API, without overwriting those two dictionaries. Retain object IDs and instance associations across branches; ranking or screen position alone does not establish instance identity.

    Save show_6D_vis1, show_6D_vis2 and MegaPose debug views to inspect projections. For numerical comparisons, check initial PnP success and valid refinement indices before converting units: HccePose / MegaPose translations use millimeters; the WAPR example JSON uses meters.

    Back-project depth

    Back-project registered meter depth z using pixel intrinsics:

    PYTHON
    import numpy as np

height, width = depth_m.shape
u, v = np.meshgrid(np.arange(width), np.arange(height))
valid = np.isfinite(depth_m) & (depth_m > 0)
z = depth_m[valid]
x = (u[valid] - cam_K[0, 2]) * z / cam_K[0, 0]
y = (v[valid] - cam_K[1, 2]) * z / cam_K[1, 1]
points_camera_m = np.column_stack([x, y, z])

    Use original-image intrinsics, not the processed-canvas matrix. Depth must already be registered and corrected under that camera model. Invalid depth produces no points. Transform meter mesh vertices into camera space using meter poses; do not apply the object pose again to observed camera-space points.

    Layers and views

    The point cloud represents observed surfaces; a mesh represents the model placed at an estimated pose. Distinguish them using separate colors and point versus surface rendering. After orbiting to inspect occluded regions, restore camera alignment. See the WAPR RGB-D viewer for interaction examples.

    Symmetric objects may have equivalent orientations, and missing depth alone does not establish a pose error. Projection and depth checks inspect geometry. Accuracy conclusions require independent ground truth and appropriate metrics.

    Public results and evaluation

    See public MegaPose and RGB examples, and historical BOP evaluation. Backend scores have different meanings and cannot be directly subtracted to rank accuracy. Record first-time setup and repeated inference timings separately.
